purpose: Experiment E-GMT-0037 in the geometry arena: repeating a bulk loop accumulates holonomy linearly (N times the single-loop rotation) and returns the frame exactly only at the commensurate meta-period, so a generic loop never repeats its viewpoint while a tuned loop closes, and a flat loop always returns.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
